name: Learning, metrics, and planning-error ledger
userOutcome: The user can see where planning and execution were inaccurate and use evidence-backed lessons to improve later projects.
productionDataSource: Plan versions, tasks, events, estimates, accepted results, costs, repairs, reviews, changes, and human decisions.
errorBehavior: Retain classified events, distinguish missing data from zero, and show metric definitions and confidence rather than false precision.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not merge scope changes with planning omissions.
Do not optimize raw agent activity.
Do not promote a wide rule without evidence and approval.
Do not imply cost accuracy beyond available data.
acceptanceTests: Compare model outcomes by task type.
